scenario.title: Concern resolved then reopened
patient_concerns: Will the medication make me drowsy at work?

transcript.content: Will this medication make me drowsy at work?
Most people don't experience significant drowsiness at this dose, so you should be fine.
Let's also talk about how to take it with food.
Actually wait -- my colleague said hers made her really sleepy for the first week. Are you sure I'll be okay driving to work?
That's a fair point to raise again -- individual reactions do vary, so let's be cautious: avoid driving for the first few days and monitor how you feel.
